hard_constraints: Describe the Force through body-experience first, analysis second: render sensation (warmth, chord formation) before diagnostic terms like 'Weave-Resonance' (force_mechanics.sensory_vocabulary.concept_vs_sensation_rule)

Use exact weave-resonance vocabulary for Force-sensitives: discordant start (three notes not forming a chord), breakthrough (stops trying to lead and listens; emergent relationship; physical warmth after cold; Weave as living tissue, flexible/dynamic; relief not triumph) (force_mechanics.force_sensitive.weave_resonance)

Avoid forbidden repeat phrases: no 'reached for the Force', 'the Force was still there', 'like a handrail in the dark', 'the note held slightly below pitch', 'the Weave itself', 'the lattice itself' (force_mechanics.vocabulary_variation.forbidden_repeat_phrases)
Ben's close third-person POV only: no access to Sera/Kael interiority; register their states physically (jaw set, hands shaking) (pov_structure: Single POV — Ben Skywalker throughout)
Era-appropriate terminology: 'the Weave' lowercase unless sentence start; in-character variants per speaker but narrator uses 'the Weave' sparingly (terminology_registry.The Weave)
canon_risks: Multi-tradition resonance (Jedi/Sith-trained/NSW-era) risks implying Force unity incompatible with Legends light/dark polarity; mitigate by emphasizing AU 'harmonic resonance' as local reinforcement of damaged Weave, not universal ontology (force_mechanics.primary_rule: light/dark natural; technique damages, does not prove imposition)
legends_continuity_notes: Ben Skywalker (47 ABY): Jedi Knight post-Fate of the Jedi/Abeloth; experienced from GAG service, civil war, Vestara betrayal; Skywalker reflex to lead/control canon to character (canon_preserved.Ben Skywalker as Jedi Knight; ensemble_cast.ben.three_dimensions)

Force wounds persistent in Legends: Malachor V (KOTOR II: mass death wound, echo effects), Nathema (TOR: ritual-stripped Force); scene builds on these as precedent for Veranthos wound/seal (force_mechanics.canon_grounding; terminology_registry.Nathema, Malachor V)
Vergences canon: natural Force concentrations (e.g., Valley of the Jedi); Veranthos as vergence explains wound severity (terminology_registry.Vergence)
required_context_for_drafter: Setting: Veranthos mid-valley near Scar (three-meter vertical distortion); lush/overgrown but wrong; wound-pressure amplifies emotions but resonance counters it (terminology_registry.Veranthos, The Scar; force_mechanics.thin_places_high.full_unweaving)

Characters: Ben (interpretive axis, lets go of control); Sera (NSW Jedi, architecture perception: Weave as load-bearing; jaw sets); Kael (Sith-trained conscript, Weave as foreign accent now home-like; hands shake) (force_mechanics.character_differentiated_sensations; terminology_registry.Sera Varik, Kael Drenn)

Key beats: Discordance critical (Sera jaw, Kael tremble); Ben releases control (breath/weight shift/open hands); chord forms (three traditions self-align); warmth floods linked hands/palms; wrongness quiets (scene_card.key_beats; action_beats)
Emotional arc: Desperate control -> surrender -> breakthrough warmth/relief (scene_card.emotional_arc; emotional_trajectory)
AU elements active: Resonance as shared-burden (Ben/Sera/Kael traditions); pays PP10/13/14 (scene_card.promises_paid); advances Ben arc to new_truth_demonstrated (pov_arc_phase)
allowed_au_divergences: Weave-Resonance: multi-tradition harmonic reinforcement distributing seal load; untested until climax (canon_overridden.Weave-Resonance; force_mechanics.weave_resonance)
Veranthos wound/seal: Gavran's technique damage at vergence; contained by anchors (now failed); resonance as plural solution (canon_overridden.Battle of Veranthos, The Seal, Anchor)
Survivors as anchors: Sera (Jedi Knight), Kael (Sith-trained), Torin (Battle Master) awake in 47 ABY; Veraine escaped (canon_overridden.Darth Veraine, three Jedi survivors)
